Class TUI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.view.TUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
DisplayableView, ViewInterface, Serializable, Remote
public class TUI extends Object implements DisplayableView
A text-based user interface (TUI) for interacting with the game. This class implements the `DisplayableView` interface and handles the visual representation of the game's state in the terminal.
